nodes.label: Student AI Coach Correctness Validation
nodes.rationale: Validates POST /api/copilot/coach against live Supabase JWTs/real ELO history/real ANTHROPIC_API_KEY spend by diffing every number Capi states against the student's real dashboard — any mismatch is P0.

nodes.label: Cross-Role Validation
nodes.rationale: Repeats the correctness prompts across all 7 streams (Embedded, Analog Layout, Mechanical, Civil, MBA, Pharmacy, Data Analyst) watching specifically for non-IT streams silently getting IT-flavored advice, the platform's single most likely failure mode given its IT-first history.

nodes.label: Failure-Mode / Fallback Validation
nodes.rationale: Flips ENABLE_MCP_COACH off/on in the real environment to confirm CopilotWidget.jsx's Groq-fallback logic fires correctly end-to-end in a live browser session — the sandbox test only proved the backend half (503 in ~40ms).

nodes.label: Coach Invocation Logging Verification
nodes.rationale: The /coach route emits one structured coach_invocation JSON log line per call (no new DB table); once confirmed real, these lines alone derive AI success rate, MCP failure rate, tool usage, latency, and top questions without a dedicated analytics backend.

nodes.label: Operational Readiness Checklist
nodes.rationale: Load test at realistic cohort size (the stdio MCP bridge is a single spawned process per backend instance, so concurrent tool calls queue through one client), monitoring, backups, and verifying aiLimiter thresholds before opening to a full college.
